summary: Executed targeted backend regression plus mobile-web UI validation for inbox voice translation controls, call speaker-control changes, and partial multi-context room checks. Backend mostly passed (6/7) with one blocking practice-call precondition failure; frontend validated key QA2 translation behavior but several required multi-user flows remain unverified.

critical.issue: Regression test failed twice with 409: 'Leave your current call or voice room before starting another.' This blocked the 600-second practice-call timer/privacy flow test path.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin login did not land on admin page in this run; it routed to /onboarding before manual navigation to /voice.

issues: Required long-text collapsed/expanded icon cluster alignment could not be conclusively validated because target collapsed text controls were not found in current visible thread state.

rca_of_issue: Practice-call regression failure RCA: the suite expects a clean pre-call state, but server rejects /rtc/practice/call with 409 when either participant is already in an active call/voice room. Repro: run TestPracticePrivacyAndTimer::test_practice_call... -> POST /api/rtc/practice/call returns 409 immediately. Mitigation: ensure teardown clears lingering room memberships/calls for QA users before test start (or add pre-test cleanup endpoint calls).
